display_name: Pensions Act 2014 (UK) under one top-level goal — the new state pension (entitlement, full, reduced and transitional rates with Schedule 1), deferral increments, and bereavement support payment entitlement — and those three goals

others: the kind of state pension for (pa14-state-pension.l4)
the amount for pre-commencement qualifying years for (pa14-state-pension.l4)
the weekly increase for deferral in (pa14-deferral.l4)
is entitled to bereavement support payment (pa14-bereavement.l4)

scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: ss 1(2), 2-4, 5(1), 17(1)-(4), (7), 30(1), (5)-(6B), 31 and Schedule 1 paras 2, 4, 6, 7 of the revised text as at 29 April 2026. Inputs: the day of pensionable age (the table amended by s 26 is lost in conversion), qualifying years, rates, the old-system rate and contracting-out amount, deferral dates and percentage, bereavement facts. Left out on purpose: survivor's pensions, reduced rate elections, pension sharing, up-rating, Parts 2-6 apart from ss 30-31.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-18 (tests-independent.l4, 90 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read); none failed. The formulas in s 3(2) and Sch 1 paras 4(4), 7(3) are lost in conversion and used in their printed form N/35. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: Lost formulas: N/35 of the full rate.
forks.F2: Pensionable age on 6 April 2016 is not 'before'.
forks.F3: A pre-commencement year plus the minimum in total gives s 4 (transitional), never s 2.
forks.F4: Sch 1 para 6: up to the 2016 full rate revalued by the full-rate ratio; the excess by the revaluing percentage.
forks.F5: s 5(1): greater of the capped sum and the pre-commencement amount alone.
forks.F6: s 17(3): whole weeks = days (both ends counted) ÷ 7, rounded down.
forks.F7: s 17(2): no increase under 1% of the weekly rate.
forks.F8: s 30(1)(b): death before the claimant's pensionable-age day.
forks.F9: s 31(1): one tax year with contributions actually paid giving an earnings factor of at least 25 × that year's LEL.

checks.result: 7 modules: 128 assertions satisfied, 0 failed, 0 other errors (38 encoder, 90 independent)
